## Bestiary — complete proposed source-authoring return

```text
COMPLETE_SCOPED_PROPOSED_BESTIARY_AUTHORING_WITH_DECLARED_CONTENT_HOLDS_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
```

**The return supplies complete proposed operations for all 66 printed creature profiles, preserves the additional lore-only dossier, and dispositions all 27 current questions plus the retained legacy questions and interfaces.** It includes the full private Director manuscript, original source/history records, material comparisons, complete cases and reversible operations.

**Nothing was applied or independently accepted by this delivery.** Applied coverage remains **525 reviewed / 323 pending / 249 standalone / 173 scoped interfaces**, with **50 accepted-but-unapplied ordinary spell identities**. FT84’s scoped acceptance remains separate from the pending parent335 gate. Resonance Fields3’s receipt review remains separate.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[Download the complete bestiary source-authoring return](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01.zip)

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}[Read the complete review](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/REVIEW.md) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}[Read the proposed MODEL](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/MODEL.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}[Read the full private Director manuscript](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/DIRECTOR_REVIEW.md) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}[Read the review receipt](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/REVIEW_RECEIPT.json)

## 1. Source preservation and authority

Both submitted archives are included **byte-identically** under `input/`. The nested V2 archive remains intact.

The returned source/history records retain:

| Source inventory | Preserved |
|---|---:|
| Known dossiers | **67** |
| Printed stat blocks | **66** |
| Existing public routes | **26** |
| Printed actions | **162** |
| Multiattack entries | **42** |
| Printed trait entries | **136** |
| Damage-average observations | **119** |
| Harvest occurrences | **178** |
| Workbook/runtime bindings | **707** |
| Historical field differences | **184** |

The additional lore-only dossier does **not** acquire an invented stat block. Historical runtime names, aliases and values remain comparison evidence; they do not overwrite current dossier identities.

Current **EX58, LAX and TEX** sources control within their actual scopes. The fulfilled EX58 X01 correction is not treated as outstanding, and its earlier prepared/conditional status is not revived. The complete accepted Companion05 and Rank7 models are included as separately bound source-specific authorities. The whole-game map remains evidence inventory—not approval of its 75 requirements.

**The five sealed dossiers were not reviewed as creature content, rendered into the new manuscript or assigned new public routes.** Their bytes remain in the unmodified original source container for containment and integrity purposes.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}[Complete source bindings](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/SOURCE_BINDINGS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="6"}[Authority and precedence](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/SOURCE_AUTHORITY.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="7"}[Full native/history preservation](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/NATIVE_HISTORY.json)

## 2. What is operationally authored

Every printed profile has its complete native record beside the proposed body geometry, action procedures, trait procedures, knowledge boundary, retreat behavior and finite harvest handling.

**Printed HP, AC, CR, type, ability values, attack modifiers, dice and stated defenses remain unchanged.** Missing mechanics are labelled **new scoped authorship**, rather than represented as recovered source text.

### Actions, damage and Multiattack

All **162 actions** have explicit operational treatment. The **42 Multiattacks** specify their permitted constituent attacks, one actual Action commitment, ordered subattacks, independent rolls and damage events, and the consequences of a miss or changed target eligibility.

Multiattack does not manufacture extra Actions, Reactions, resource refreshes or unlisted recharge attacks. Printed attack bonuses control; they are not “corrected” by recomputing an assumed player-character proficiency formula.

The damage-average comparison confirms the supplied observation: all **119 printed averages** agree with ties-to-even rounding of their exact dice means. **That remains a display-pattern observation.** Actual damage uses the declared dice and applicable modifiers, not the printed average.

The encounter states also include the existing Wound handling. Qualifying packets receive their actual check; a resulting effective-maximum clamp is recorded separately and does not become another damage event.

### Geometry and formation identity

Missing reach, range, area shape and body-space details receive explicit profile-local completions. Source-defined geometry remains controlling. A natural feature’s name does not automatically grant flight, swimming, burrowing, incorporeality or a new movement speed.

For the selected aggregate/formation profiles, the proposal uses **one printed mechanical actor with finite positioned members**:

- The formation has one printed HP account, Action budget, Reaction budget and finite remains history.
- Member positions matter for actual reach, line of effect, local coverage and targeting.
- Splitting visible members does not create more stat blocks, commands, XP opportunities or harvest inventories.
- A qualifying area application against that unit resolves its shared recipient damage once, rather than multiplying the packet by every intersected member.

This is **new formation authorship**, not a global ruling that all similarly named creatures are swarms or aliases.

### Pressure Wave receives its missing procedure

The Pact Automaton’s Pressure Wave retains **DC16** and **3d10 thunder**. The new completion is a **30-foot cone, STR save**, with:

**Failure:** full damage, a bounded ten-foot push along the defined direction and actual Prone.  
**Success:** half damage, no new push or Prone.

Its independent worked example rolls **16 damage**. The failed recipient takes 16 and receives the admitted movement/posture consequences; the successful recipient takes 8.

The separate printed **Containment Pulse** keeps its own Strength-save procedure. Pressure Wave does not silently replace it or inherit a different DC.

### Traits, recharge tells and counterplay

All **136 printed traits** have complete selected procedures, with their source names retained. They are organized into operational families without replacing the individual rules.

Recharge uses each actual printed threshold and a defined spent/ready history. Telegraphs communicate observable readiness or preparation; **they do not grant a free Reaction, reveal hidden recharge dice or create an interruption ability**.

The creature dossiers’ noncombat counterplay—territory, seals, anchors, credentials, sensory cues and emotional behavior—is preserved through explicit evidence and action requirements. A prose weakness does not automatically become an unprinted damage vulnerability.

Regeneration, on-death effects, phase/visibility behavior, fear, grappling, conditional attack modifiers, resistance and other families retain distinct triggers and ending rules. No generic foreign-game trait package is imported.

## 3. Death, harvest, knowledge and expedition integration

### Finite remains and material provenance

All **178 harvest occurrences** retain their exact source identities and native names. The proposed extraction procedures use finite corpse/source slots, actual work, tools, checks, custody and loss records.

Repeated callbacks, corpse fragmentation, copying, suppression or return do not replenish a consumed source slot. Gear is not silently converted into harvest material, and harvested material is not automatically a soul entitlement.

The catalog comparison remains:

**34 literal-name correspondences · 144 unmatched occurrences · 38 unresolved recipe references**

A literal name match is **not** proof of ingredient equivalence. The complete comparisons preserve catalog identifiers, source text and the actual unresolved relationship. Unmatched yields are not assigned invented market prices or recipes simply to make a crafting example succeed.

The positive harvest fixture completes its actual ten minutes and creates one source-linked unit. The repeated claim produces no second unit. Custody and later valuation route into the actual EX58 contracts.

### Current reviewed status versus missing operative content

The current crafting index marks **Refined Verdant Tackle** reviewed. That status is preserved.

However, its **complete operative card is absent from the supplied archives**, so this return does not reconstruct its mechanics from the label or treat the historical preliminary verdict as current. The hold is on executing that missing exact card—not on reopening the entire reviewed crafting system.

### Knowledge, language and retreat

The 26 existing public routes remain unchanged. The full manuscript is **private Director/source material**, not a newly published player bestiary.

Knowing a dossier ID does not confer combat statistics, weaknesses, language fluency or hidden source information. Language and research procedures route through actual LAX permissions. Knowledge examples retain their real evidence, checks and disclosure limits.

Retreat uses actual movement, visibility, pursuit and expedition contracts. The proposal does not add teleporting escape, automatic catch-up, duplicated withdrawal rewards or a new free off-turn action.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="12"}[Every material/recipe comparison](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/MATERIAL_RECIPE_COMPARISONS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="13"}[All harvest dispositions](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/HARVEST_DISPOSITIONS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="14"}[Language access](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/LANGUAGE_ACCESS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="15"}[Souls, research and Null boundaries](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/SOULS_RESEARCH_NULL_BOUNDARY.json)

## 4. All current and historical questions remain present

`QUESTION_DISPOSITIONS.json` contains the **complete original question text**, selected answer, status and source references for:

| Question set | Coverage |
|---|---:|
| Current mapped questions | **27** |
| Legacy unresolved interfaces | **13** |
| Original source questions | **16** |
| Original runtime questions | **8** |
| Historical difference groups | **12** |
| Original crafting questions | **13** |

The new 27 dispositions supplement these records; they do not replace them. Their selections address geometry and units, printed numeric authority, action budgets, Multiattack, recharge, damage/defense routing, trait behavior, Pressure Wave, formation identity, language/knowledge, retreat, death, harvest, recipe comparisons, historical aliases and public/private boundaries.

Where a question depends on genuinely missing operative content, its answer identifies that dependency rather than treating a rejection guard as implementation.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="16"}[All complete question dispositions](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/QUESTION_DISPOSITIONS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="17"}[New authoring decisions and tradeoffs](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/DECISIONS.json)

## 5. Encounter and specification coverage

The casebook contains **89 authored cases and 343 independent branches**:

| Category | Cases | What they establish |
|---|---:|---|
| Native-profile encounter fixtures | **66** | One for every printed profile, including all 42 Multiattacks; independent miss and critical branches |
| Cross-interface encounter fixtures | **7** | Pressure Wave, formation targeting, harvest, language, recharge, retreat and material routing |
| Trait-family state specifications | **16** | Qualified/blocked trait dispatch and state boundaries; **not authenticated world encounters** |

The native encounter snapshots include actual body geometry, attack bonuses, dice, HP/effective maximum/temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, Action budgets and source-event history. Pure ranged fixtures are outside adjacent-hostile range. A target is not silently moved between subattacks to make each attack legal.

The trait-family specifications are deliberately distinguished from those encounters. They do not create a default campaign character or claim that a predicate test exercises a complete AI, scheduler or combat engine.

The isolated suite independently checks **592 damage packets, 583 attack applications and 42 qualifying Wound checks**, as well as pressure-cone geometry, formation accounting, recharge thresholds and finite harvest claims.

All test opponents, skill values, stock and external inputs are disclosed fixtures. They are not new canonical acquisitions, creature ratings or authenticated campaign events.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="18"}[Complete casebook and full state branches](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/CASEBOOK.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="19"}[Individual case dispositions](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/CASE_DISPOSITIONS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="20"}[Numerical/state evidence](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/NUMERICAL_STATE_EVIDENCE.json)

## 6. Genuine holds and limits

The bounded catalog’s **seven printed exact-CR2 creatures include no printed Undead**. Its four printed Undead have other CRs. **That finding establishes nothing about creatures outside this catalog.**

Consequently, none of the following whole positive-case holds is cleared:

**IN6-09-A, IN6-09-B, EN5-01-A, EN5-01-B and EN6-03-B.**

The proposal does not change CR/type to satisfy Command Undeath, infer companion CR from owner level, inherit a donor’s rating or convert saving-throw proficiency into Athletics.

Other retained boundaries include actual-world fixture authentication, unmatched material and recipe links, the missing full Verdant Tackle card, source-only runtime aliases and the later implementation of body, trait, phase, knowledge, custody and harvest behavior.

Full Ready, canonical Shaman Step, active next-healing consumption and downstream expiry choice/removal remain independent obligations. Parent335, pending Resonance Fields3, human gameplay, numerical balance, cosmology, 75-domain closure and release are not approved here.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="21"}[Complete hold register](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Bestiary_Complete_Source_Part5_Return_01/HOLD_REGISTER.json)

## 7. Exact reconstruction and verification

The package contains **71 full-value reference operations and their inverse**. Every complete before-value is retained in the exact source payload inside the unchanged V2/V3 input; every complete after-value is delivered in `MODEL.json`.

Forward reconstruction produces the entire proposed MODEL. Reversal restores the entire original source-model bytes. Complete profile before/after views are also retained.

**Pointer reconstruction and complete replacement views describe the same change. They are not two plans to apply consecutively.** Any later working-tree difference requires a newly bound reconciliation, not an overwrite.
